sourceText:
Italian Braised Chicken
By: Amanda Parks
Published: Tuesday, April 19, 2011 - 9:03am

Ingredients




2 tablespoons of unsalted butter (softened)
1 tablespoon of extra virgin olive oil
2 tablespoons of spaghetti sauce
6 chicken tenderloins or 3 chicken boneless skinless chicken b
1 teaspoon of minced garlic
1 medium onion, sliced
1 yellow or orange bell pepper, sliced into strips
1 cup of chicken broth or red wine
Salt and Pepper to taste

Preparation

1 Heat olive oil in large skillet until it ripples 2 Add chicken to pan, add salt and pepper to taste 3 Cook chicken on each side for about 4 minutes 4 Set chicken aside on a plate or plastic wrap 5 Add bell pepper and onion 6 Add butter 7 Turn heat to medium and saute mixture for about 15 minutes or until the vegetables are soft. 8 Add in the spaghetti sauce and cook vegetables for another 2 minutes 9 Add chicken broth or red wine 10 Add chicken back to pan in the vegetable mixture 11 Reduce heat to low and cover 12 Simmer for 10 minutes 13 Serve with risotto or rice.

About


I found a similar recipe with tomato paste instead of spaghetti sauce and pork chops instead of chicken. We don't eat a lot of pork so we substituted the chicken. Then, I forgot to pick up tomato paste at the supermarket, so I substituted spaghetti sauce. It was a huge hit, my family was asking for seconds.
